items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He played trombone, and he did it in a comic manner. He was big and fat. And his nickname was Big Belly Five-Ball. And he worked in the bands around. So you saw him.

ctx.x: Tapo [SPELLS] His name was... I can't think of his last name, but... Yeah, it's Tapo. Yeah, that's right. Tapo. He played trombone, and he did it in a comic manner. He was big and fat. And his nickname was Big Belly Five-Ball. And he worked in the bands around. So you saw him.

Now, there was Manuel Perez, who was the top trumpet player around here, Downtown. Like, everybody respected him as a reading musician. He went to Chicago. He went up there and joined Charlie Elgar's band.
